subject: CORRECTION: key_points [x,y] array format is CORRECT for ALL 24 graphs
body:
Previous advisories (0053, 0061) incorrectly stated that RP9 key_points as [x,y] arrays was a bug.

Full audit confirms: ALL 24 graphs across ALL 12 exams use [x,y] array format for key_points. This is the correct, universal schema. NOT a bug.

Prior advisory about 'RP9 Q13 key_point as array' was wrong. Please disregard.

The REAL RP12 bug still stands: RP12 Q12 has 7 key_points instead of 5.

No action needed for key_point format.
